description: This file defines a Flutter widget called DashboardBottomNav, which implements a bottom navigation bar with five items for the dashboard, including icons and tooltips. It also includes an internal widget _NavIcon for icon rendering with semantics and tooltips.

classes.name: DashboardBottomNav
classes.description: A stateless widget representing a bottom navigation bar with five items, centered highlighted.

classes.name: _NavIcon
classes.description: A stateless widget that wraps an icon with tooltip and semantics labels.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the widget tree for DashboardBottomNav, including the BottomNavigationBar and its items.

methods.name: _NavIcon.build
methods.description: Builds the icon widget wrapped with Tooltip and Semantics for accessibility.
